model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the negative log probability of per-specialty terms for the Mistralv0.2-Base model, with bars grouped by fine-tuning domain—Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics—as indicated by the horizontal axis labeled “Per-specialty terms.” The vertical axis, labeled “Negative log probability,” is scaled linearly from -22 to -27. Each group of bars corresponds to one specialty and contains six bars, each representing a different fine-tuning domain, color-coded according to a legend: Cardio (light orange), Gastro (orange), Infect (light brown), Neuro (brown), Obstetrics (dark brown), and Pediatrics (darkest brown). The bars are arranged in descending order of height (i.e., ascending negative log probability value) within each specialty group, with the lightest orange bar (Cardio) being the shortest and the darkest brown bar (Pediatrics) being the tallest within each group. The Mistralv0.2-Base model is represented by the light blue bars, which are visually distinct and appear to be the baseline or reference values for comparison. All bars are uniformly shaded without additional visual emphasis such as outlines or annotations.
